headline: Türkiye's BIST 100 Index Climbs 2.2% at Weekly Close
summary: Borsa Istanbul's BIST 100 index gained approximately 233 points, climbing 2.2% at Friday's closing session.
why: Benchmark equity indices gauge local investor confidence and domestic economic performance in emerging markets.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: The BIST 100 index closed up 2.2% for the session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
